name: Centiel AG
summary: Centiel AG designs, manufactures, and supplies uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems in Switzerland. Its products include three phase, including modular and standalone; single phase, such as cumuluspower X1, essentialpower X1; and energy storage products. The company also provides UPS Network Management Software that collects and analyzes real-time data, allowing users to predict equipment health trends and make proactive recommendations. In addition, it offers solutions, such as containerised UPS, railway, emergency lighting, medical special, and customized solutions.
